_comment: P0-05 ranking-tolerance fixture for skills/skill-scout/scripts/score-candidates.js. Invented, inert candidates with full SKILL.md bodies (skill_md_content). scripts/score-candidates.test.js scores them in the legacy (body) form and in the agent-output form derived from them (body removed, body_keyword_hits computed by the scorer's substring rule) and asserts the same ranking and scores. Nothing here is a real skill or a real repository. Record: docs/evaluations/2026-10-25-p0-05-scout-read-only-fetcher.md.
installed_skill_descriptions: Use when auditing a skill sourced from GitHub for prompt injection and malicious scripts before installation.
Use when evaluating a skill's effectiveness with structured test scenarios.

candidates.name: pr-reviewer
candidates.description: Use when the user asks for a code review of a pull request; checks style, tests and risky changes.
candidates.skill_md_content:
# PR Reviewer

Review a pull request end to end.

1. Read the diff file by file.
2. Note risky changes and missing tests.
3. Write the findings as a short list.

candidates.name: ts-diff-check
candidates.description: Use when changing TypeScript code, when asked to compare two versions; lists type errors.
candidates.skill_md_content:
# TS diff check

Compare the staged diff with the previous commit.

Run the type checker on the changed files and report each new error with its line.
For a security-sensitive file, add a note.

candidates.name: secure-review
candidates.description: Checks code for secrets and unsafe calls.
candidates.skill_md_content:
# Secure review

Use during a security review of TypeScript or JavaScript projects.

1. Scan every changed file in the diff.
2. Flag hardcoded secrets by location and kind only.
3. Flag unsafe eval-like calls.

candidates.name: changelog-writer
candidates.description: Use when writing a changelog entry, release notes; when user asks to summarise merged work.
candidates.skill_md_content:
# Changelog writer

Read the merged pull request titles and write a changelog entry.

candidates.name: review-diff-lite
candidates.description: Use when asked to review a diff; short comments only.
candidates.skill_md_content:
# Review diff lite

Give three comments at most.
